messages:
Aisha (Eng Ops): Quick Q&A: drop any questions about release cadence, oncall, quality bars, SLAs here — Tom and I will answer live.
Priya (Eng Manager): Will the weekly release window stay as-is or move to biweekly?
Tom (CTO): Short answer: we're moving toward a hybrid cadence. Weekly for hotfixes and critical infra changes; feature releases will generally target a biweekly cadence starting Q3. We want predictable cutoffs.
Aisha (Eng Ops): TL;DR: weekly for ops/patch, biweekly for features. We'll publish the schedule and tagging rules.
Marcus (SRE): What about oncall rotations — any plan to change primary/secondary lengths?
Tom (CTO): We9re standardizing to 2-week primary, 4-week secondary on most squads (exceptions for tiny teams). This reduces churn and improves knowledge handover.
Leah (Product): How will SLAs be communicated to customers vs internal SLOs?
Tom (CTO): Customer SLAs will remain contract-level and tied to Dedicated offerings; internal SLOs will be in the Console and linked to runbooks. We'll add a column in the product roadmap view: SLA-affects (yes/no) so PMs and Eng know impact.
Priya (Eng Manager): Any change to quality bars for canary vs GA?
Aisha (Eng Ops): Quality bar proposal posted in #eng-quality yesterday — short version: canary requires 95% pass on smoke + critical evals, GA requires 99% on stability and no open P0/P1 for 48h.
Marcus (SRE): Will deploy automation enforce the canary gates?
DeployBot: CONFIG: canary_gate = true; health_checks = ["latency","error_rate","tail_99"]
Marcus (SRE): Yes, DeployBot will block rollout unless checks pass. We9re working on more readable failure reasons.
Tom (CTO): Also adding an automated rollback for tail_99 > 2x baseline in canaries.
Leah (Product): If a feature misses the biweekly cutoff, what's the default? Keep in branch or ship as hotfix?
Priya (Eng Manager): Default: hold for next biweekly unless it's customer-blocking or a security fix. Use the flag `release.exempt=true` for exceptions.
Aisha (Eng Ops): Quick logistics: we'll publish the cadence doc + release playbook to the Handbook by EOD Friday. Please review and comment.
Marcus (SRE): One more ask: can we get better visibility into cold-start latency regressions in the Console? Those impact our SLAs.
Tom (CTO): Agreed — adding a dashboard card for cold-start P50/P95 and alerting when P95 increases by >30% vs baseline.
Leah (Product): Thanks — helps product prioritization.
Priya (Eng Manager): Will we have metrics for oncall load (alerts/week per person) so rotations can be evaluated?
Marcus (SRE): Yes, building a weekly digest to track alert volume, MTTR, and paging frequency per rotation.
Aisha (Eng Ops): Thanks everyone. If you have follow-ups after this thread, ping me or Tom. We'll summarize and post meeting notes. :thumbsup:
Tom (CTO): Thanks — appreciate the good questions.
DeployBot: DEPLOY: rollout check completed for infra-canary-2024-05-16 — PASSED
Aisha (Eng Ops): Thread closed; notes will be in the all-hands follow-up doc.
